links.outcome: Adherence of RAG-generated recipes to health guidelines and sustainability criteria
links.effect: 80.1% adherence to health guidelines (calories, fiber, fats) and 92% compliance with sustainability criteria across 1,000 recipes; no non-RAG comparator reported.
links.quote: In evaluating 1,000 recipes, the system achieved 80.1% adherence to health guidelines meeting targets for calories, fiber, and fats and 92% compliance with sustainability criteria, emphasizing seasonal and locally sourced ingredients.

unlisted_practices: Iterative automated validation loop (virtual nutritionist) refining generated recipes against nutritional and sustainability criteria
Local deployment of the LLM to maintain privacy

screen.reason: Evaluates a custom RAG-based LLM system (virtual nutritionist using LLaMA3) for personalized smoothie recipes, measuring compliance with nutritional and sustainability criteria across 1,000 generated recipes without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or comparative practice.
